issues.reason: Categorical statements bars predicating a members' property of the group symbol (a bare (Member <group> <prop>) is reserved for properties of the collection itself), and 'dim' is incidental description that never fuses, so (Member (sk_dim_lanterns $h) dim) asserts the collection-as-object is dim — the exact reading the plural rules warn against — instead of distributing over the members.

gaps_confirmed: a definite plural restricted by a relative clause ('the nightmoths that survive the hunt') as the consequent subject of a whenever rule: neither the definite-plural group-witness prescription nor the per-member-variable route is designated for this position
'toward' as a directional oblique: the whither test points at Goal but Goal's own listing is 'to / into / onto', while the never-a-synonym-head rule points at a surface (Toward ...) — unresolved
new_gaps: no licensed form for distributing a descriptive modifier over a Skolem group minted inside a rule conclusion: the mandated per-member (Implication (PartOf $x <group>) (Member $x <prop>)) must reference the occurrence-bound group and so must nest inside the conclusion, a nesting the instruction set licenses only inside sealed terms
defect_summary: The compliant form keeps (GroupOf (sk_dim_lanterns $h) lantern) and hands 'dim' to the members via a per-member distribution rule (Implication (PartOf $x (sk_dim_lanterns $h)) (Member $x dim)) rather than (Member <group> dim) — though whether that distribution rule may nest inside a rule conclusion is itself unlegislated, filed as a gap.
notes: Everything else in the rule — the donkey-style premise reusing $h for 'the hunt', survive with Agent/Theme, the (sk_flee $n $h) Skolem over both universals, During, and the 1.0/0.9 TV — is compliant.
